import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec2, vec3, mix, smoothstep, length, abs, max, texture, uniform } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, PlaneGeometry, Mesh, Texture } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  // STAGE BACKDROP - Prevent FLAT_VOID with a rich dark vertical gradient (surface #0b0b10 to ink #16161d)
  const bgGeom = new PlaneGeometry(12, 10);
  const bgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  const bgUv = uv();
  bgMat.colorNode = mix(
    vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063), // #0b0b10
    vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114), // #16161d
    bgUv.y
  );
  const bgMesh = new Mesh(bgGeom, bgMat);
  bgMesh.position.z = -2.5;
  group.add(bgMesh);

  // RADIAL CONTACT SHADOW
  const shadowGeom = new PlaneGeometry(3.0, 1.0);
  const shadowMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true });
  const shadowUv = uv();
  const radialDist = length(shadowUv.sub(0.5).mul(vec2(2.0, 1.0)));
  const shadowAlpha = smoothstep(0.5, 0.0, radialDist).mul(0.5);
  shadowMat.colorNode = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
  shadowMat.opacityNode = shadowAlpha;
  const shadowMesh = new Mesh(shadowGeom, shadowMat);
  shadowMesh.position.set(0, -0.6, -0.05);
  group.add(shadowMesh);

  // MAIN INTERACTIVE CARD CONTAINER
  const badgeGroup = new Group();
  group.add(badgeGroup);

  // Procedural capsule SDF Node setup
  const badgeGeom = new PlaneGeometry(2.4, 0.8);
  const badgeMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true });

  // Uniform to drive adaptive glow focus on interactive events
  const focusProgress = uniform(0.0);

  // Initialize ceramic grain texture mapping
  const dummyTex = new Texture();
  const grainTexNode = texture(dummyTex, uv().mul(2.0));

  // SDF calculation for 2.4 x 0.8 capsule
  const p = uv().sub(0.5).mul(vec2(2.4, 0.8));
  const extents = vec2(1.2 - 0.35, 0.4 - 0.35);
  const dNode = length(max(abs(p).sub(extents), 0.0)).sub(0.33);

  // Layout color vectors
  const inkColor = vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114);    // #16161d
  const surfaceColor = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063); // #0b0b10
  const paperColor = vec3(0.91, 0.93, 0.95);      // #e8ecf2
  const accentColor = vec3(1.0, 0.164, 0.22);     // #ff2a38 (Signal Red)

  // Surface texture blend with base dark filling
  const baseFill = mix(surfaceColor, inkColor, grainTexNode.r);

  // Segment masks
  const fillMask = smoothstep(0.008, -0.008, dNode);
  const edgeMask = smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(dNode.add(0.008)));

  const dynamicEdgeColor = mix(paperColor.mul(0.4), accentColor, focusProgress);
  const compositeColor = mix(baseFill, dynamicEdgeColor, edgeMask);

  badgeMat.colorNode = compositeColor;
  badgeMat.opacityNode = fillMask;

  const badgeMesh = new Mesh(badgeGeom, badgeMat);
  badgeGroup.add(badgeMesh);

  // Async texture loading
  const textureUrl = config.imageUrl || '/prism-assets/chrome/ceramic-grain.map.png';
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(textureUrl).then((realTex) => {
    if (realTex) {
      realTex.wrapS = ctx.THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      realTex.wrapT = ctx.THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      dummyTex.image = realTex.image;
      dummyTex.source = realTex.source;
      dummyTex.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  });

  // TEXT CAPTION LAYER
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const textVal = textItems.length > 0 ? textItems[0].text : 'COLLECTION';

  const textNodeObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(textVal.toUpperCase(), {
    fontSize: 0.10,
    color: '#e8ecf2', // paper
    align: 'center',
    letterSpacingPx: 8
  });
  textNodeObj.position.set(0, -0.035, 0.02);
  badgeGroup.add(textNodeObj);

  // INTERACTIVITY & GSAP EVENT SIGNALS
  group.userData.handlers = {
    pointerover: () => {
      // Rise-in subtle lifting
      gsap.to(badgeGroup.position, { y: 0.15, z: 0.1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out' });
      gsap.to(shadowMesh.scale, { x: 1.2, y: 1.2, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out' });
      gsap.to(focusProgress, { value: 1.0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' });
    },
    pointerout: () => {
      // Gentle settle
      gsap.to(badgeGroup.position, { y: 0, z: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power4.out' });
      gsap.to(shadowMesh.scale, { x: 1.0, y: 1.0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power4.out' });
      gsap.to(focusProgress, { value: 0.0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out' });
    },
    pointerdown: () => {
      // Press-down interaction
      gsap.to(badgeGroup.scale, { x: 0.94, y: 0.94, z: 0.94, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out' });
    },
    pointerup: () => {
      // Weighted-settle overshoot
      gsap.to(badgeGroup.scale, { x: 1.0, y: 1.0, z: 1.0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'back.out(1.7)' });
      ctx.emit('hub-collection.select', { context: 'badge' });
    }
  };

  // CLEANUP DISPOSAL
  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    gsap.killTweensOf(badgeGroup.position);
    gsap.killTweensOf(badgeGroup.scale);
    gsap.killTweensOf(shadowMesh.scale);
    gsap.killTweensOf(focusProgress);

    bgGeom.dispose();
    bgMat.dispose();
    shadowGeom.dispose();
    shadowMat.dispose();
    badgeGeom.dispose();
    badgeMat.dispose();
    dummyTex.dispose();
  };

  return group;
}
